info.name: AgriMatch API
info.description: Test collection for the AgriMatch farm-equipment sharing API.

request.description: Run the folders top to bottom (Collection Runner). Each run registers fresh users, so no seed data is needed.

exec: pm.test('Returns token and farmer without password', () => { pm.expect(j.token).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(j.farmer).to.not.have.property('password_hash'); });
pm.test('Returns token and farmer without password', () => { pm.expect(j.token).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(j.farmer).to.not.have.property('password_hash'); });
pm.test('Paginated envelope', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('pagination'); });

pm.test('Period listed with approved_bookings', () => { const p = pm.response.json().data.find((x) => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('periodId')); pm.expect(p).to.exist; pm.expect(p.approved_bookings).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('Pending and bound to token user', () => { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('pending'); pm.expect(j.requester_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('requesterId')); });
